title: TTF Eases to €46.70 as Hormuz Fears Recede, HH Drifts to $2.77
edito: Europe enters the critical summer injection campaign at a multi-year storage low while Hormuz remains locked in diplomatic stalemate. The triple threat of stalled LNG flows, a structural supply deficit, and Norwegian maintenance creates asymmetric upside risk — but the binary possibility of a sudden diplomatic breakthrough demands hedging. Position for the tail, respect the range.

title: TTF Surges 7% to Retake €49 as Geopolitical Risk Flares, HH Slips to $2.83
edito: The gas market is walking a tightrope, caught between the bullish trio of Hormuz risk, a deep EU storage deficit, and upcoming Norwegian maintenance. The path of least resistance is higher, with any supply disruption likely to have an outsized impact on prices.

title: TTF Pulls Back to €45 as Hormuz Premium Unwinds, HH Firm at $2.83
edito: Hormuz has moved from scenario to reality — 20% of global LNG is disrupted and Europe faces its toughest storage refill campaign in years at just 32% full. The triple threat of Hormuz, storage deficit, and Norway's hydro gap creates an asymmetric setup: the path of least resistance is higher for summer TTF. Trade the convexity — buy summer calls or strangles to position for a potential supply squeeze, while respecting the binary downside risk of a diplomatic breakthrough.

title: TTF Surges 5.6% to €47.10 on First Hormuz LNG Transit — HH Drifts Near $2.68
edito: Hormuz Day 64 brings a potential inflection: the first LNG tanker to cross the strait since the war began. Yet one transit does not break a blockade — and Europe enters injection season at its lowest April storage since 2018. The council audited 18 trade ideas and retained 10: the core conviction is a barbell of calendar spreads and tail-risk calls, with unanimous support for the TTF Jun €55 call as the cheapest insurance in a binary market.
